items.title: Why Is People (PPLI) Stock Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of digital media conglomerate People (NASDAQGS:PPLI) jumped 7.7% in the pre-market session after reports revealed that MGM Resorts is considering making a takeover bid for the company.

items.title: Akamai Technologies Soars on Anthropic Deal; Costco Earnings Beat | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Akamai Technologies (AKAM) shares soar after the cloud provider inked a seven-year $11.6 billion deal to provide computing power to Anthropic. Analysts say the deal should boost Akamai's growth and its profitability profile looks attractive, given the contract is entirely focused on CPUs. - People (PPLI) shares jump on a report that MGM Resorts is discussing making a bid to purchase the Barry Diller-owned media giant. - Costco Wholesale (COST) quarterly profits surpassed Wall Street's estimates after the company recorded a benefit related to tariff refunds.

items.title: MGM, People Inc. Switch Places In Merger Talks. People Inc. Soars.
items.summary: People Inc. and MGM Resorts played a round of musical chairs in the midst of their ongoing merger talks.  MGM Resorts is now exploring a bid to buy People Inc., reversing their previous roles, according to The Wall Street Journal.  Meanwhile, MGM Resorts had much more muted gains of about 0.5%.
